title.narrative: Development Assistance Reporting to OECD, 2023 data cont. and 2024 data – consultancy and support

description.narrative:
To assist and advice on correct reporting, both process and context of official development assistance and other official assistance, reporting on private sector instruments and mobilised private capital.
To quality assure external partners data submission if relevant.
To provide expect advice in relation to OECD related dialogue and further quality assurance if relevant.
To assist with related general aspects that are of a complex nature and that are included in the OECD DAC Working Party on Development Finance Statistics: Converged Statistical Reporting Directives for the Creditor Reporting System (CRS) and the Annual DAC Questionnaire.
